jp_election.name: Town of Barnet Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Barnet justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term (Shellie Samuels, William Graves, Susan Coppenrath, Stanley Robinson, Rebecca Boardman, Dennis McLam, Maurice Roberts); they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
